scope: All 21 exact family-plan entries: 14 ml-training-evaluation and 7 audio-production-analysis. Classification metadata was used only to resolve the fixed set; each body is bound to the hash and read evidence in source-integrity.json.

neutralContract.outcome: An evidence-bounded validation design and result for a scientific prediction model used in screening, optimization, or data acquisition.
successEvidence: intended prediction domain and decision stated before scoring
split prevents related cases crossing the holdout
candidate and simple baselines use matched rows and split
errors and uncertainty are examined by group and training-domain coverage
adaptive campaigns retain selected, unselected, failed, and negative outcomes
observed evidence separated from estimates and claims
inputs: candidate-selection and outcome records when adaptive
operations: evaluate with held-out groups or untouched test data
inspect residuals, coverage, uncertainty, and adaptive-selection records
neutralContract.effects: Local analysis and report artifacts only. No training, acquisition, publication, deployment, or automated scientific decision is authorized by this method.
dependencies: enough independent groups for the chosen split
out-of-fold or held-out predictions for performance claims
full candidate/outcome record for a full-pool adaptive claim
failureModes: negative or failed outcomes silently removed
selection leaves only chosen cases labeled
uncertainty evaluated in-sample or assumed to transfer under shift
neutralContract.termination: Return a bounded result or stop without a generalization claim and state the smallest missing evidence.
